**Finding: compliant (no redline proposed).**

The document contains no audit, inspection, verification, or records-examination right running against Clear Capital. Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation) — the location the planner flagged as most likely to carry such language — is purely a billing/invoicing and tax mechanic, and Section 1(c) addresses only Contractor personnel's compliance with our security policies when working at our facility, not any verification access. Targeted searches for *audit*, *inspect*, *examine*, *verify*, *records*, *usage/licence compliance*, and *premises/system access* surfaced nothing responsive.

Because no audit right binds us, we sit better than the AUDIT preferred position (frequency, notice, business-hours, independent-auditor, cost-allocation and no-system-access limits are all moot), and inserting audit machinery would only weaken our position. If RadialSpark later seeks verification rights, we hold the fallback line: once per year, 15 days' notice, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%.
